clips.title: The story
paras: At a watchtower northwest of Razor Hill, Furl Scornbrow keeps watch over Durotar. Too old for the front lines, he crafts sturdy packs for young travelers.

Furl Scornbrow watches the central plains from a wooden tower northwest of Razor Hill. In the tense days after Orgrimmar was founded, sentries like Furl sounded signal horns against hostile quilboar, centaur, and Kul Tiras interlopers. Durotar has since grown more stable, and Razor Hill has secured its borders. Emergencies come less often, leaving Furl long quiet hours at his post.

Furl says his old bones and fading strength leave him unable to fight. Still, an orc does not easily surrender their purpose. He uses his hands to make canvas sacks and packs for fresh recruits carrying supplies. In exchange for coarse thread and practical materials, he equips green adventurers setting out to prove their worth to the Horde.
